newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 6-,9-mo T-bill yields same, 12-mo down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 6-,9-mo T-bill yields same, 12-mo down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six- and nine-month treasury bills were unchanged and 12-month yields eased slightly from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.
Six-month bills stood at 20.15 percent, nine-month yields remained at 28.14 percent, and 12-month bills slipped to 30.46 percent from 30.48 percent.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.63 million UAH 13.63 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 24.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 38.00 million UAH
Amount sold 163.47 million UAH 38.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 135.03 million UAH 31.39 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,634,692 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
